name.en: Browser check of an accepted task

description.en: The browser check of an accepted task: a child thread drives the BB browser on the project's Browser QA machine and returns a verdict per case and viewport. The stage receipt browser-qa is written as always. Lane Pilot starts it from lane_pilot_helpers (action browser_qa).
description.ru: Проверка принятой задачи в браузере: дочерний тред ведёт браузер BB на браузерной машине проекта и возвращает вердикт по каждому случаю и ширине экрана. Квитанция этапа browser-qa пишется как всегда. Запускается инструментом lane_pilot_helpers (action browser_qa).

not_for: anything a person asks in a chat: the PM starts it with lane_pilot_helpers (action browser_qa)

run_id.note: the Lane Pilot run of the PM chat (lprun_...)

dev_server.note: the start command of a dev server that is not running; the check starts it in a BB terminal and closes it afterwards

nodes.rule: code: runBrowserQa writes the browser-qa stage receipt; a check still running after a reload is read back from that receipt until it is final

title.en: Fail the run when the check is red

nodes.rule: code: a check that ended failed, blocked or could not be run fails the run; the reply stays in the qa step
